Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoplayer

Class VideoItem

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoplayer.VideoItem
public class VideoItem extends Object
One entry of the video player's library: a local movie file, a network stream URL, or an optical disc device. Items are plain Jackson beans persisted by VideoPlayerStore, so the class stays serialisable (no-arg constructor plus getters/setters, no live handles).

location is an absolute file path, a URL, or a disc device such as /dev/sr0; the VideoItem.Kind records how the entry was added so the UI can show the right glyph and the backend can build the launch command.
